steps.change: Qualify the reconciler host's hourly cloud verification on a fresh local guest

services.origin: Git daemon serving the revision as main and production
services.monitor: Gatus from the gatus role's pinned layer
services.github: App token endpoint verifying the RS256 JWT and the token revocation

verification_unit.go: Ubuntu go1.26.0 switched to go1.27.1 through GOTOOLCHAIN
verification_unit.checkout: production only; checkout, Go toolchain, module and build caches, tools and HOME in a per-run directory

report.state_store: lock and status read from MinIO through AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3
report.rulesets: compared anonymously with live fredrir/infra; no differences

credential_isolation: apply credential and Gatus token absent from the uploaded report and log and from the unit journal
limitations: The guest has no Kubernetes API, OpenTofu state or runner fleet, so verification stops at the published Flux revision; unit tests cover the OpenTofu, runner-registration and host-free paths
Tags transport and infra_binary are skipped: the guest has a simulated tailnet interface and runs the revision's own supervisor build instead of the pinned release

credentials.delivery: credentials.sops.yaml encrypted to the guest's /etc/age/host.key, installed as root 0600 ciphertext by host_secrets
credentials.decryption: root ExecStartPre decrypts only the verify map into /run/infra-reconcile-verify; the supervisor deletes it once read
